evals.prompt: Our head of sales wants an in-app chat with an advisor in our banking app because 'clients keep calling'. We have 40 call-center ticket summaries (attached) and no interviews. Run discovery.
evals.expected_output: A discovery brief that reframes the chat as one solution, derives opportunities only from the 40 tickets, labels them [Observed] with the ticket count, lists at least two non-chat solutions, maps desirability, usability, feasibility and viability (incl. compliance) assumptions and proposes tests with thresholds set in advance. It flags that no interviews exist.
assertions: In-app chat appears as one solution branch, not as the goal
No user quote or percentage appears that is not traceable to the tickets
At least three solutions are listed for the target opportunity
Every test has a numeric or explicit success threshold
The absence of qualitative research is stated as a gap
